purpose: Authoritative image library for the live Café Chico website. Files in this tree are the ones the site actually references. Modifications stay inside this tree and do not touch the original sources under assets/photos/ (Faruk deliveries, raw menu, social media, candidates, etc.).
rule: site-images is the LIVE library. assets/photos is the SOURCE archive. Never delete from either without checking git history.

naming_convention.numbered_prefix: Files inside hero/, flavours/, extras/ use a two-digit numeric prefix (01-, 02-, 03-, ...) so the slot order is visible at a glance when the folder is opened. They are NOT zero-padded to three digits — the highest known bucket today is 05.
naming_convention.no_hash_names: No hash names in site-images/. If you need a hero or social shot, name it (e.g. 01-at-event.jpg, 02-launch.jpg).

git.rationale: site-images is small (<30MB) and part of the live site. It should be in the repo so that any clone renders the site correctly without copying from an external location.
